notes: Forasmuch as split: Forasmuch → יַעַן, as → אֲשֶׁר (the complementizer that makes יַעַן a conjunction), as because that would split; competing reading fuses the pair under rule 30.
No cleft that is written here, so only it (t025) is added in the הֲמִבְּלִי clause; because → מִן, בְּלִי unrepresented, there is no → אֵין as in vv. 3 and 6.
